required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 31 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is `decision_meta` present, valid, `APPROVED`, and on legal mainline `engineering_branch`?
Does `skill_profiles` use only active skills from `.codex-skills/registry.json`?
Does `codex_execution_report.md` match this decision ID and round ID?
Does `execution_report.md` semantically match `codex_execution_report.md`?
Does `pytest_result.txt` match this decision ID, round ID, and report ID?
Does `pytest_result.txt` status agree with command block exit codes and final-check/run-closeout evidence?
Does `command_plan.json` carry current decision and round IDs?
Does command-plan authorize every executed command?
Were any omitted or unauthorized commands executed?
Does execution-log record every command-plan required command?
Does execution-log provenance match live pytest_result, command_plan, and run_closeout evidence?
Does `prework_provenance_result.json` remain current and pass?
Does report-summary match the execution report status, files_changed, tests_ran, generated_artifacts, and required audit coverage?
Does Required Audit coverage pass without placeholder or question-misaligned answers?
Does status-policy reject accepted claims when final-check or run-closeout evidence is failed?
Does final-check pass before closeout?
Does close-round archive the current round if closeout is permitted?
Does final-check after closeout pass or is there no active post-close nested failure?
Does `run_closeout_result.json.closeout_status` pass if command-plan permits closeout?
Does the current round manifest exist and match the current report if closeout is permitted?
Does final gate contain no active blocking reasons?
Are all changed source/test files explicitly allowed by this decision?
Does the round avoid forbidden paths?
Did the implementation avoid Web/frontend runtime, runner dispatch, workflow dispatch, model API invocation, database writes, cleanup apply, sample solving, and external reverse tools?
Did this round preserve existing timestamp precision hardening and prework provenance behavior without reimplementing them unnecessarily?
Did this round reuse existing project_gate/report/final-check/closeout foundations instead of adding a parallel mechanism?
Does the final conclusion avoid claiming `ACCEPTED` or `ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS` unless all hard gates and closeout support it?
`ACCEPTED`
`ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS`
`REWORK_REQUIRED`
`BLOCKED`
